name: omp-chatgpt-web
description: Oh My Pi harness backed by normal ChatGPT Web chat with native MCP tool calls.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run smoke && npm run mcp:smoke
scripts.chatgpt:check: npm run build && node dist/cli.js browser-check
scripts.chatgpt:login: npm run build && node dist/cli.js browser-login
scripts.chatgpt:setup: npm run build && node dist/cli.js browser-setup
scripts.chatgpt:doctor: npm run build && node dist/cli.js doctor
scripts.chatgpt:chat: npm run build && node dist/cli.js chat
